claims.text: Many customers praise the shaver for giving a close, smooth shave and cutting hair evenly without pulling.
Battery life is a common complaint, with several reviewers reporting short runtime, dead batteries, or misleading battery displays.
Some units stopped working entirely after a short period of use, leading to returns or replacements.
Reviewers appreciate the included accessories and multi-use attachments.
Cleaning is a recurring issue, as hair stubs clog the rotating heads and require frequent maintenance.
